attributes.name: Eastside
attributes.description: A combination of multi-use trail and linear greenspace, the Atlanta Beltline Eastside Trail was the first finished section of the Atlanta Beltline in the old rail corridor. The Atlanta Beltline Eastside Trail, which was funded by a combination of public and private philanthropic sources, runs from the tip of Piedmont Park to Reynoldstown.
